O.outcome_detail: angular error when pointing to unseen landmarks

result.effect: F1,25 = 13.384, p = 0.001, partial η² = 0.349; 31.8% lower angular errors

cells.quote: In addition, a statistically signiﬁcant difference in angular errors for the different trial conditions ( F1,25 = 13.384, p = 0.001, partial η2 = 0.349) with less angular errors in augmented landmark trials ( M = 2.866, SE = 0.115) than that in non-landmark trials, ( M = 3.776, SE = 0.231) by .911 (95% CI, 0.410 to 1.411) degrees was observed.
cells.note: The study reports this as a repeated-measures ANOVA, with SBSOD included as a covariate in an ANCOVA for angular errors.

O.outcome_detail: distance travelled in the wayfinding task

cells.quote: With the aid of a VGL, participants travelled a 43.0% shorter distance, which revealed optimal route-planning with VGLs. ANOVA showed a signiﬁcant difference in the distances travelled (F1,26 = 26.939, p < 0.001, partial η2 = 0.509) with a shorter distance participants travelled in VGL trials ( M = 23.501, SE = 0.343) than that travelled in non-VGL trials ( M = 33.606, SE = 1.968) by 10.104 (95% CI, 6.103 to 14.106) metres.
cells.note: The study states that participants were 27 students from the University of Technology Sydney; it does not state their prior knowledge or expertise.

O.outcome_detail: number of fixations on local landmarks

result.effect: F1,25 = 68.721, p < 0.001, partial η² = 0.733; 144% higher fixations without VGL

cells.quote: As a comparison between the ﬁxation on local landmarks in trials without and with VGLs, the results indicated that participants more often ﬁxated on the local landmarks when they did not have a VGL to orient to, leading to a 144% higher number of ﬁxations on local landmarks.
cells.note: The study interprets fewer local-landmark fixations with VGL as different, more efficient landmark use; fixation count is a behavioral process measure rather than a direct spatial-knowledge test.

cells.quote: However, while entering SBSOD scores as a covariate, because of the signi ﬁcant negative correlation between the VGL trial and SBSOD test (rs(27) = –.471, p = 0.013), the ANOVA did not reveal any statistical difference between the response times for the two trial conditions (F1,25 = 1.269, p = 0.271, partial η2 = 0.048).
cells.note: The study tested VGL and non-VGL trials within participants; the non-significant result is coded ns because no equivalence test or adequate-power claim is reported.

cells.quote: For the statistical detail, the ANOVA results of the pointing task revealed a statistically signi ﬁcant difference in response times between trials with and trials without augmented landmarks (F1,26 = 6.311, p = 0.019, partial η2 = 0.195) with shorter response times in VGL trials ( M = 22.899, SE = 1.056) compared to trials without augmented landmarks ( M = 26.673, SE = 1.521) with a difference of 3.774 s (95% CI, .686 to 6.86).
